architectureDecisions: Application owns WHAT: packages/agentic-system/src/oracle.js parses raw Backend/Qa WorkOrders, selects the declared requirements already carried by those parsed orders, calls Oracle, then validates the returned plain object with BackendContextSchema/QaContextSchema. Application retains lifecycle, acceptance, recovery and product-currentness authority.

Adopt the exact concrete seam already authorized by BB-060: @exharness/oracle exports pullBackendFiles(parsedOrder,{repositoryReader}) and pullQaArtifacts(parsedOrder,{artifactReader}). BB-061 must not rename them to a generic or source-class API unless a new Research plan explicitly supersedes this contract.

pullBackendFiles accepts the application-parsed plain order without importing its runtime schema, checks repositoryReader.readFile, invokes it once per requiredFiles entry in order with exact repositoryRef/revision/path, preserves content and sourceRef, and assembles the plain {repository,files} object that the Application adapter validates.

pullQaArtifacts accepts the application-parsed plain order without importing its runtime schema, checks artifactReader.readArtifact, forwards each required artifact plus upstream identity exactly in order, preserves content/sourceRef, attaches the existing APPLICATION_ARTIFACT producer/acceptance provenance, and assembles the plain {upstream,artifacts,acceptanceCriteria} object that the Application adapter validates.

The application-owned adapter is the deliberate semantic port: it supplies a parsed application shape and owns final schema validation; Oracle only structurally consumes fields and assembles source results. This lets Oracle assemble application-required shapes without importing application orchestration or schema modules.

Reader failures keep the existing Backend/QA message and original cause; invalid raw orders fail before IO; malformed returned content/sourceRef fails only at the Application ContextSchema boundary. Oracle never fabricates defaults, acceptance or currentness.

Dependency direction is both metadata and runtime source: packages/agentic-system declares file:../oracle and its thin adapter imports ../../oracle/src/index.js; packages/oracle imports no packages/agentic-system or Core module. Keep relative runtime wiring for current no-install CI.

BB-061 execution is gated on a BB-060 DONE receipt. The worker first verifies the delivered functions, adapter and dependency edges against the BB-060 READY plan; any material difference is PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION and returns to Research instead of broadening implementation.
implementationSlices: O21 — Require BB-060 DONE, load its delivery receipt and consolidated Living Oracle refs, and verify that pullBackendFiles, pullQaArtifacts, the thin Application adapters and Application -> Oracle dependency were delivered exactly. On mismatch stop with PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

O22 — Stabilize the BB-060 concrete semantic port without renaming it: Oracle consumes parsed plain orders, performs only ordered injected reads/error preservation/provenance assembly, and returns the two exact pre-schema plain objects. Remove any Oracle import of Application/Core runtime or any lifecycle/acceptance decision.

O23 — Keep packages/agentic-system/src/oracle.js as the application-owned semantic adapter: parse before IO, call the matching concrete Oracle function, then run BackendContextSchema.parse or QaContextSchema.parse. Preserve resolveBackendContext/resolveQaContext signatures and index exports used by Backend and QA.

O24 — Enforce the acyclic compile-time seam in package metadata and actual ESM imports, retaining file:../oracle plus ../../oracle/src/index.js for no-install CI. Add negative fixtures for reverse imports, raw-order parsing or ContextSchema ownership moved into Oracle, generic resolver/provider seams, and lifecycle/acceptance leakage.

O25 — Run Oracle unit, Application integration, architecture-boundary and full Agentic regression checks; update Living Oracle and Agentic Application docs to the delivered seam and record exact verification evidence.
